Generator total 953.62 g; the 48.62 g above 905 g is taken off the printed parts only (x0.7338); listing masses kept. Not current: the robot is not wearing the pack. Built 2026-11-24 by cmu/model/flightpack-v1-w918-20261124/build_variant.py.
